content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic:
Operator-installed correlation rule (CortexSim never writes it). Alert name EXACTLY as this rule's name; severity Medium; Scheduled, every 10 minutes, query time frame 1 hour; alert field mapping: agent_hostname -> Host Name, agent_id -> Agent ID (the mapped artifacts are what let a correlation issue join a case); MITRE tag T1219 only, so the issue is not credited to another step's row by technique. UNTESTED: this XQL has not been run in any tenant. Its shape follows CR-EDR-0023, which was tested read-only in the lab tenant on 2026-11-11. It is built only from events SIM-KOI-012 produces on one host, and every leg also matches the unmirrored path the real threat uses (/tmp/ld.py and a hidden six-character file under /tmp). It fires when the RAT runs a hidden dot-file AND at least two of the other three legs are present, so one missing file sub-type does not silence it. While the events stay inside the one-hour time frame it fires again on every scheduled run. XQL:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter agent_os_type = ENUM.AGENT_OS_LINUX
| alter leg = if(event_type = ENUM.FILE and action_file_path ~= "node_modules/plain-crypto-js", "package", if(event_type = ENUM.FILE and action_file_path ~= "/tmp/ld[.]py$", "rat_dropped", if(event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START and action_process_image_command_line ~= "/tmp/ld[.]py +https?://", "rat_launched", if(event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START and actor_process_command_line ~= "/tmp/ld[.]py" and action_process_image_path ~= "/tmp/[.][A-Za-z0-9]{6}$", "payload_executed", "other"))))
| filter leg in ("package", "rat_dropped", "rat_launched", "payload_executed")
| alter payload = if(leg = "payload_executed", 1, 0)
| comp count_distinct(leg) as legs, max(payload) as payload_executed, count() as events, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by agent_hostname, agent_id
| filter legs >= 3 and payload_executed = 1
rules.name: KOI-012 Axios Postinstall Dropper To Python RAT Payload Execution
